title: Investigation of Discretionary Lane-Changing Decisions: Insights From the Third Generation Simulation (TGSIM) Dataset
source_location: Data Preparation, equations (1)-(4), Table 1, PDF pp.3-4

sample_definition.window: 3 s before and 3 s after the vehicle centre crosses the lane boundary
sample_definition.neighbour_filter: both target-lane leader and follower present, longitudinal distance no greater than 500 m at crossing

body_clearance_mapping.equal_length_limit: Both length corrections vanish only when the corresponding vehicles have equal length

sampling_scope: If used, independently sample primitive speeds/relative speeds/time gaps and deterministically derive physical positions. Do not claim the derived distances are independent or reproduce the natural joint distribution.

source_roles.ego_and_target_lane_neighbours: Zhang et al. Table 1 interquartile envelopes; negate the published relative speeds to express positive closing speed
source_roles.original_lane_leader: Cai et al., DOI 10.3390/machines11040426, section 4.1, Figure 7(a), Table 2: 5-40 m/s lead speed and 15-100 m body clearance for the same initial ego-following-lead relationship

proposed_design.sampling: independent uniform primitive parameters, Sobol design, 2000 target candidates and 512 separate historical design points

fixed_context.vehicles: ego, original-lane lead, target-lane lead, target-lane rear
fixed_context.ego_manoeuvre: Controlled by the actual ADS. Lane-change duration, decision and speed response are outputs rather than sampled inputs.

engineering_definitions: Use published pooled decision-window interquartile limits as a declared logical design envelope at initialization, not as measured initial-state marginals
Compose the original-lane following relationship and target-lane interaction envelopes by their physical roles; do not claim one natural traffic cohort or preserve empirical correlations
Derived physical speeds and distances need not be mutually independent; only the seven primitive inputs are sampled independently
The three background vehicles' subsequent response laws and common geometry must be fixed in B2; these ranges define initial kinematics only
predeclared_feasibility: Initial full footprints and actual observation history are valid
Speeds, geometry and intended road/route lie in the declared native ADS execution scope
Do not screen candidate coordinates using target collisions, RSS, lane-change success or test-method discovery counts
Freeze geometry and dynamic checks before generation and disclose resulting conditional dependencies

unresolved: The role-based logical composition and pooled-window envelope are engineering choices requiring clear reporting, not a recovered initial-state distribution
All actor speeds and contexts must be checked against the common public ADS execution scope before any final range is frozen
Native observation history, actual vehicle lengths, background responses and full execution semantics remain unverified
library_check: No TGSIM or Discretionary title found in the user-provided Google Drive folder; the author-hosted full text supplied the formulas. No Drive files were changed.

mapping_verification.varying_values: ego speed, two closing speeds, two time gaps, three vehicle lengths; two endpoints each
mapping_verification.checks: positive derived speeds and body gaps; source time-gap equations recovered from derived centres; relative-speed sign conversions
mapping_verification.scope: Algebra only; no physical execution, native dynamics or ADS validation
